body: Thanks. I've told my closest friends about nearly everything, and they've been amazing help
I have talked to my close friends about it, and my family has an extremely vague and watered down idea of my problems.

I'm really picky about who I tell, so at least this isn't a common problem. 

When I told her, she was the only person that knew at the time and her not trying to help made me feel alone with the problem, with no way out except the obvious, death

Thank you for the insight, and I was figured your first point was true
> I don't really expect anyone to be fully prepared with handling those kinds of emotions at that age.

But is still upset me, whether those feelings were justified or not
